GamesGoodboy GalaxyVersionNintendo SwitchEditionDigitalAnimated Blood, Comic Mischief, Fantasy ViolenceLoadingNintendo Switch 2 Compatibility InformationSupported – Game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch. Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces. A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Nintendo Switch™, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.Maxwell’s homeworld is nearing collapse. In a last ditch-effort to find help, he hyperjumps where no dog has gone before. Stranded, he finds himself on the edge of a hostile system - if there’s any hope of return and rescue he’ll need every friend (and every weapon) he can find.Forced to confront this celestial expanse head on, Maxwell stays strong - determined to keep his head up and lend a helping hand to everyone he meets on his journey. Like all underdogs, the odds are stacked against him, but you can’t keep a good dog down.Key Features· Explore jam-packed levels with multiple routes· Make 50+ friends & collect their friendship cards· Upgrade your blaster with special abilities· Find hidden areas and take on a variety of boss battles· Local couch co-op multiplayer mode· Bonus prequel content: Chapter ZeroSoftware description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 337 MBNintendo Switch 2: 337 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Lyrics, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol and TobaccoIn-Game PurchasesGamesLet's Sing 2027VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalLyrics, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol and TobaccoIn-Game PurchasesLoadingSing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.Grab the mic—or your smartphone—and get ready to shine! Let’s Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics from around the world. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable duets and group performances. Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let’s Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. Whether you’re hosting a party or chasing your best score, it’s your turn to take center stage!This year, step into Soundtown in an all-new Party mode—a lively musical adventure where you’ll face off against DJ Hush and bring the beat back to the city. With improved visuals, fresh avatars, and customizable rewards, every performance feels like a moment in the spotlight.Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.* Chappell Roan – The Subway* Lady Gaga, Bruno Mars – Die With A Smile* Alex Warren – Ordinary * Drake – God's Plan * Ariana Grande – we can't be friends (wait for your love)* Sabrina Carpenter – Espresso * Ed Sheeran – Azizam ...
